name: prana-platform
description: PRANA DeFi Platform - Production-ready staking and exchange platform

scripts.deploy:production: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run validate
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run clean && npm run build:staging
scripts.serve:prod: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{const file=path.join('./dist',req.url==='/'?'staking.html':req.url); if(fs.existsSync(file)&&!fs.statSync(file).isDirectory()){const mimeType=req.url.endsWith('.js')?'application/javascript':req.url.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':req.url.endsWith('.html')?'text/html':'text/plain'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mimeType}); res.end(fs.readFileSync(file));}else{res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found');}}); server.listen(8080,()=>console.log('🚀 Production server: http://localhost:8080'));"
scripts.serve:staging: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{const file=path.join('./dist-staging',req.url==='/'?'staking.html':req.url); if(fs.existsSync(file)&&!fs.statSync(file).isDirectory()){const mimeType=req.url.endsWith('.js')?'application/javascript':req.url.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':req.url.endsWith('.html')?'text/html':'text/plain'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mimeType}); res.end(fs.readFileSync(file));}else{res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found');}}); server.listen(8080,()=>console.log('🚀 Staging server: http://localhost:8080'));"
scripts.full-deploy: npm run compile && npm run generate-abis && npm run deploy:testnet
scripts.setup: echo '⚙️ Setting up PRANA platform...' && npm install && echo '✅ Ready! Run: npm run dev'
